summary: Advance to researcher. Plan revised to target descriptive metrics on a single benchmark (BigBench) under fixed token budgets, acknowledging the impossibility of finding controlled A/B tests for dynamic vs. static memory.
body: The previous research loop failed to find 4 sources comparing dynamic vs. static memory under identical fixed token budgets, as such controlled experiments do not exist in the literature. The plan has been revised to accept descriptive evidence (success/hallucination rates, resource usage) on a single, reproducible benchmark (e.g., BigBench) while explicitly documenting the absence of direct baseline comparisons. This aligns with the project's evidence standards and avoids forcing unsupported causal claims. The next task is a bounded inspection of available literature to gather these descriptive metrics.
